meta.scope: Reference numbers for the browser demo. Everything below is produced by the repository's own Python models; no experimental measurement, no ROS 2 run and no hardware result is included.

meta.note: Portable re-implementation of the reference grid-world experiment. Every number here is produced by this file; the browser engine re-derives them from the same seed and must agree exactly.

latency.caveat: First-order kinematic model: the robot is assumed to keep its velocity until the delayed update arrives, and no controller, estimator or environment interaction is simulated. Values are analytical, not measured.

link_budget.caveat: The three per-strategy rates (50 / 5 / 0.5 Mbps at 10 Hz) are order-of-magnitude figures taken from LiDAR data-sheet and interface budgets, and are linear in the update rate by construction. They are planning assumptions, not measurements from a testbed.

numpy_reference.description: Original NumPy implementation: sensor-free random walk (a robot marks only the cells it walks over), two strategies, partial diffs chosen as a random subset.
